description: Make ProviderSpec a generic facade through the registry for model/provider/endpoint/auth option translation. Remove Codex-specific clauses and helpers; preserve public APIs and caller contracts. Test option precedence and extension without facade branching.

comments.text: ProviderSpec now normalizes one context and delegates provider atom, fixed URL, model spec, credential options and defaults through the static registry. Removed all Codex references/helpers from facade. Resolved options override conflicting advanced auth/account fields. Updated Agent service ownership docs.

title: [zaq-vuo.3] Delegate ProviderSpec and remove special cases
